The unhealthy in-cluster configuration reader pod (`app-844dc9f957-hm2l8`) was failing due to insufficient permissions. To restore it while preserving least-privilege access, I have updated the associated ServiceAccount (`config-reader`) with a custom Role and RoleBinding that grants only `get` and `watch` permissions specifically for `configmaps` in the `default` namespace. Finally, I deleted the failing pod, allowing Kubernetes to reschedule a new instance with the corrected permissions.
